mechanics: Casting Demonic Empowerment summons a Pit Lord minion for 20 sec that casts Abyssal Strike (Fire) at your target every 2.5 sec.
Also grants Empowered by the Abyss to you and allies within 30 yd for 20 sec: spell power equal to 14% of your bonus spell power, snapshotted at cast.
While the ring is worn Demonic Empowerment has the configured cooldown.

mechanics: Immolate applies (or restarts) Malediction: a 24 sec Fire DoT, 8 ticks, total damage 300% of SP (snapshotted at the Immolate).
Chaos Bolt or Shadowburn landing on a Malediction target adds a stack (uncapped) and refreshes it; each added stack has a 25% chance to start Igniting.
Igniting: every 1 sec one stack is consumed for a flat Shadowflame hit of 60% SP, down to 1 remaining stack. While igniting, Chaos Bolt/Shadowburn only refresh.
legendaries.name: Morgrath's Malediction

related_spells.name: Morgrath's Malediction
related_spells.tooltip: Casting Immolate also applies Malediction to your target, dealing Fire damage over 24 sec. If the target is afflicted by Malediction, casting Chaos Bolt and Shadowburn increases its stack count by 1. Each time Malediction gains a stack it has a chance to collapse, consuming a stack every 1 sec to deal Shadowflame damage until 1 stack remains.

notes: Tier sets: 4 pieces (neck, ring, cloak, weapon) at item level 271; bonuses at 2 and 4 pieces. Every tuning value is the live server value.
Legendaries: item stats and tooltips are live; mechanics and coefficients are documented from the server scripts. Values with a "config" source are live.
Coefficients: "% of AP" means percent of the relevant attack power (ranged AP for hunters), "% of SP" percent of spell power, per hit unless stated as a total.
Numbers change during tuning; check generated_at, or fetch data.json again before a sim run.
